_comment: Template for evidence/<run-id>/evidence.json. Every value here is a placeholder: fill each from the run, never invent one. Stage 13 on 8453 is the four vault unpauses only (issue 1520, rmUSDC added by issue 1710 because all four vaults deploy paused): one govern entry per vault (unpause-USDC, unpause-PROTO, unpause-AGENT, unpause-RWA), each with its own schedule tx, its own execute tx, its own timelock operation id (operation_id, optional), the receipt statuses and the block timestamps. All four are scheduled in one sitting and wait one delay: each execute timestamp is at least 172800 s after the same entry's schedule timestamp. No two entries share a transaction or an operation id. update-delay, batch and cancel are Twin-only and are rejected on 8453. Issue 1667: a vault that pause-all paused is reopened by a numbered Safe round; for a vault paused again, add a further entry of the same step with round 2, 3 and so on (each scheduled after the previous round executed, with its own transactions and operation id). A post-launch consensus receipt release (issue 1611, never part of stage 13) goes in receipt_releases, one entry per receipt id, with consensus_receipt.address: one schedule and one execute at least 172800 s apart, target the receipt contract, calldata releaseReceipt(receipt_id). Leave receipt_releases empty when none was released. A post-launch receipt application (issue 1696, govern --row apply-receipt, never part of stage 13) goes in receipt_applications with governance.address, one entry per receipt id: ONE timelock batch of two calls, releaseReceipt(receipt_id) on the receipt contract then setDefaultWeights(vaults, bps) on the governance contract, with the vault list (vaults), the weights (bps, summing to 10000), the payload digest, the operation id, both transactions, both statuses and both block timestamps at least 172800 s apart. Leave receipt_applications empty when none was applied. No secret goes in this file.
